summary: Adds repair_cell to the self-observation job allowlist and cell display-name mapping, with tests covering classification, redaction, deduplication and distinction from matrix_cell; no actionable defects found.

evidence: ops/self-defects.ts line 64 adds repair_cell to SELF_DEFECT_JOBS and line 96 maps repair_cell (<64-hex cell id>) display names to the logical repair_cell job, removing the unknown-job attribution reported in issue 384.
.github/workflows/supervisor.yml defines the repair_cell matrix job as name: repair_cell (${{ matrix.cellId }}), the only sentinel-supervisor job name the base allowlist did not accept.
tests/repair/self_defects_test.ts verifies valid repair-cell names produce sentinel-supervisor:repair_cell keys and malformed names remain unknown-job.

tests/repair/repair_cell_self_observation_test.ts drives runSelfObservationPass and verifies the filed repair_cell report is sanitized, deduplicates across different cell ids and remains distinct from matrix_cell.
